column1: # places.tsv — freedesktop "Places" icon name -> material icon name
# Target names are lower-cased by the builder; source must be a file stem from
# icons/file/*.png, icons/folder/*.png or a generated icon (folder, folder-open).
# Covers every place name shipped by Mint-Y plus the usual Nemo/GTK aliases.
# The file manager *applications* (system-file-manager, nemo, nautilus, thunar,
# …) are answered by the Colloid apps artwork in mappings/colloid.tsv, so they
# must not be listed here: a name may only live in one context.  Only the
# location-style entries stay, because those are places, not applications.
# --- symbolic aliases (GTK would fall back anyway; explicit beats guesswork) --
